## Quarto

![Model Sampling from Conditional Distribution](images/Topic2_image.jpg)

# Solution for 1

```{r a}
mu=c(260,231,222)
S=matrix(c(2276,1508,813,
         1508,2206,1349,
         813,1349,1865),nrow=3)
l=c(1,-1,0)
m_1=t(l)%*%mu
m_1
s_1=t(l)%*%S%*%l
s_1
```

```{r b}
#| echo: false
p=3;q=2
m1=mu[1:q]
m2=mu[q+1:p]

S11=S[1:q,1:q]
S22=S[q+1,p]
S12=S[1:q,p]
S21=t(S12)

x2=225
cm=m1 + S12%*%solve(S22)%*%t(x2-m2)
cat("Conditional mean for given value of X2:",'\n',cm)

CS=S11 - S12%*%solve(S22)%*%S21
cat("Conditional covariance for given value of X2:",'\n')
print(CS)
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r a,b,c}

mu1=c(4,3,2,1)
S1=matrix(c(3,0,2,2,0,1,1,0,2,1,9,-2,2,0,-2,4),4,4,byrow = T)
q1=2
p1=4
mu11=c(4,3)
S1_11=S1[1:q1,1:q1]
S1_12=S1[1:q1,(q1+1):p1]
S1_22=S1[(q1+1):p1,(q1+1):p1]
S1_21=t(S1_12)
X_2=c(3,2)
(cond_mean=mu11 + S1_12%*%solve(S1_22)%*%(mu11-X_2))
(cond_var= S1_11  - S1_12%*%solve(S1_22)%*%S1_21)

# Drawing random sample 
library(mvtnorm)
library(MASS)
cx=(mvrnorm(50,cond_mean,cond_var))

cm_hat=colMeans(cx)
cs_hat=cov(cx)
```

# Solution for 3

```{r}
#a)
set.seed(123)
m=c(9.47,25.56,13.25,1.44,27.29,8.80)
S=matrix(c(2.57,0.85,1.56,1.79,1.33,0.42,
           0.85,37.00,3.34,13.47,7.59,0.52,
           1.56,3.34,8.44,5.77,2,0.5,
           1.79,13.47,5.77,34.01,10.50,1.77,
           1.33,7.59,2,10.50,23.01,3.43,
           0.42,0.52,0.50,1.77,3.43,4.59),nrow = 6,byrow = T)
p=6
q=3
n=150

x2=c(2.15,2.50,3.50)
X1_indices=c(2,4,6)
X2_indices=c(1,3,5)
m1=m[X1_indices]
m2=m[X2_indices]

s11=S[X1_indices,X1_indices]
s12=S[X1_indices,X2_indices]
s21=t(s12)
s22=S[X2_indices,X2_indices]

cm1=m1 + s12%*%solve(s22)%*%(x2-m2)
cs1=s11 - s12%*%solve(s22)%*%s21

# Random Sample

cx1=t(mvrnorm(100,cm1,cs1))
cm1_hat=rowMeans(cx1)
cr_hat=cor(t(cx1))
```
